The official OpenAI deprecations page (developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations) is the source of record. The search results show these dates, but some third-party sites disagree, so confirm against the official page before relying on any of them.

**Official page entries:**
- **July 23, 2026:** A batch of 15 listed model entries was scheduled to shut down, per the page's table (The public deprecations page currently lists 15 rows for that date.).
- **August 10, 2026:** gpt-5.2-chat-latest and gpt-5.3-chat-latest, with gpt-5.5 as the recommended replacement (index 2-3).
- **October 31, 2026:** Existing Evals become read-only (index 4-6).
- **November 30, 2026:** The Evals dashboard and API shut down (index 4-7). The `v1/prompts` API and reusable prompt objects are also scheduled to shut down that day (index 4-1).
- **December 1, 2026:** gpt-image-1-mini, gpt-image-1.5, and chatgpt-image-latest are removed, with gpt-image-2 as the replacement (index 2-2).

**Dates that appear only in secondary sources:**
- **August 26, 2026:** The Assistants API shuts down, with the Responses and Conversations APIs named as replacements (index 8-2).
- **September 24, 2026:** Sora 2 and the Videos API retire, with no replacement listed (index 8-2).
- **October 23, 2026:** A large batch of legacy GPT-3.5, GPT-4, GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-4o, and o-series models, plus gpt-image-1 and some fine-tuned base models (index 6-9). One source says the fine-tuned variants are included (index 8-3).
- **December 11, 2026:** The original GPT-5 and o3 snapshots (index 9-4).
- **January 20, 2027:** Legacy audio and realtime families. One source says this date is not on OpenAI's page at all (index 9-5, 9-6), which conflicts with another source's listing (index 8-4).

**Other notes:**
- Fine-tuning has its own timeline. Creating fine-tuning jobs was restricted for some organizations from May 7 and July 2, 2026 (index 3-4, 3-5). Inference on fine-tuned models continues until the base model is deprecated (index 3-3).
- OpenAI's stated notice policy is at least six months for generally available models and at least three months for specialized variants such as Codex and chat-latest models (index 6-7).
- Several third-party guides (index 1-1, 1-5, 6-3) say they were checked against the official page on dates ranging from July to August 2026. Their details don't always match each other, so treat the October and later dates as needing verification.


REMINDER: You MUST include the sources above in your response to the user using markdown hyperlinks.

The dates below come from search-result summaries, not from reading the page myself, so check them against the page.

**Next to retire, as of today (Oct 16, 2026), in order:**

| Date | What retires | Replacement |
|---|---|---|
| Oct 23, 2026 | A large batch of legacy GPT-3.5, GPT-4, GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-4o and o-series models, plus gpt-image-1 and some fine-tuned base models | not confirmed |
| Oct 31, 2026 | Existing Evals become read-only | n/a |
| Nov 30, 2026 | Evals dashboard and API, and the `v1/prompts` API with reusable prompt objects | n/a |

| Dec 11, 2026 | The original GPT-5 and o3 snapshots | not confirmed |
| Jan 20, 2027 | Legacy audio and realtime model families | not confirmed |
